top_signals.title: Most BOJ Watchers Expect Next Interest Rate Hike in December
top_signals.summary: More than 80% of Bank of Japan watchers anticipate the central bank’s next interest rate increase will come in December, according to a recent survey. None expect a hike when the bank concludes its next meeting on Oct. 30.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
